research.title: Prediction Interval Coverage Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed experiments comparing split conformal and importance weighted prediction intervals under controlled changes in feature distributions for regression tasks.
Analyzed coverage and interval width across shift conditions, examining sensitivity to density ratio estimation and calibration sample composition.

research.title: Probability Calibration Under Class Dependent Label Noise
bullets: Designed controlled label corruption experiments comparing logistic regression and neural classifiers, separating effects of noise structure from class imbalance.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, Brier scores, and log loss to assess how temperature scaling behaved across clean and corrupted calibration sets.

publications.title: Temperature Scaling with Corrupted Calibration Labels: An Empirical Study of Class Dependent Noise

work.title: Data Import Validation and Error Handling
bullets: Implemented validation checks for structured data imports, handling missing fields, incompatible types, and duplicate records within an existing processing service.
Added regression tests for import failures and corrected error handling paths to preserve actionable messages during routine service maintenance.

projects.title: Regularization Methods for Correlated Regression Features
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression workflows with standardized predictors, using cross validation to select penalties on synthetic and tabular datasets.
Compared held out prediction error and coefficient stability as feature correlations changed, examining differences between shrinkage and sparse variable selection.

projects.title: Kernel Density Estimation and Gaussian Mixture Comparison
bullets: Implemented kernel density estimation and Gaussian mixture fitting, selecting bandwidths and component counts using validation likelihood on simulated continuous distributions.
Compared held out log likelihood and density plots across skewed and multimodal settings, documenting sensitivity to smoothing choices and initialization.

projects.title: Bootstrap Confidence Intervals for Skewed Samples
bullets: Implemented percentile and studentized bootstrap intervals for sample means, comparing them with normal approximation intervals under controlled sampling distributions.
Evaluated empirical coverage and interval length across skewness and sample size conditions, examining when asymptotic approximations differed from resampling estimates.
